title: Third Alleged GTA 6 Video Leaks Online As Rockstar Scrambles
description: Another video of what appears to be legitimate Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay has leaked online with the CyberLeek watermark, prompting quick removal efforts by Rockstar.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Third Alleged GTA 6 Gameplay Video Surfaces Online

According to a recent report from gaming media outlet Eurogamer, another video showcasing what appears to be legitimate Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay has made its way onto the internet. This marks the third seemingly real video to emerge, generating significant buzz within the gaming community.

Reports indicate that the latest footage bears the watermark of a group allegedly connected to earlier leaks from the same day, identified as CyberLeek. In response to the circulating footage, developer Rockstar Games has reportedly scrambled to remove the unauthorized material from various corners of the internet.

## The Ongoing Challenge of Game Development Secrecy

For a massively anticipated title like Grand Theft Auto 6, maintaining strict confidentiality during development is notoriously difficult. Unauthorized leaks often disrupt official marketing plans and put immense pressure on the development studio. Rockstar's swift action to purge these videos highlights the company's aggressive stance on copyright protection and information security.

However, it is important to note that these leaked materials remain unconfirmed by official sources, and players should approach any circulating footage with caution until official announcements are made.

## Editor's Take

These repeated leaks underscore just how intense the global appetite is for any news regarding GTA 6. While the circulating videos create a temporary media storm, Rockstar's rapid takedown efforts show they are firmly in control of their IP. Fans are best served by waiting for official, polished reveals rather than chasing unverified leaks.
